name: Behobia-San Sebastian 20K
summary: An iconic and demanding 20K road race from Behobia to central San Sebastian, crossing Irun, Gaintxurizketa, Errenteria, Pasaia, Miracruz, and Gros before finishing on Alameda del Boulevard.
heroNote: The strongest cheering stretches are at Gaintxurizketa, central Errenteria, Miracruz, and from Gros and Zurriola beach through to the Boulevard finish.
specialNote: The organizer has not yet published the 2026 course; this map uses its currently published route GPX. General runners start in groups from 10:00, so check the runner's bib for their exact start time; elite women start at 09:55.
